avoid_supplements.name: Fluvoxamine
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP1A2 inhibitor dramatically increases tizanidine levels, risking severe hypotension, bradycardia, and syncope
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; use alternative SSRI if antidepressant needed

avoid_supplements.name: Ciprofloxacin
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP1A2 inhibitor significantly elevates tizanidine concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; substitute with non-CYP1A2 inhibiting antibiotic

avoid_supplements.name: Kava Kava
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression and hepatotoxicity risk; may potentiate muscle relaxation effects
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue kava kava; counsel on CNS depression risks

avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inducer may reduce tizanidine efficacy; also increases CNS effects unpredictably
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid combination; consider alternative mood support

caution_supplements.name: Valerian Root
caution_supplements.mechanism: Additive CNS depression may increase sedation and dizziness
caution_supplements.action: Use cautiously; monitor for excessive drowsiness; counsel on combined CNS effects

caution_supplements.name: Ginseng
caution_supplements.mechanism: May partially induce CYP3A4, potentially reducing tizanidine levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor efficacy; adjust tizanidine dose if needed under clinical supervision

caution_supplements.name: Magnesium Supplements
caution_supplements.mechanism: May have additive muscle relaxant properties
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for excessive weakness or hypotension; use standard supplemental doses

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibitor significantly increases tizanidine bioavailability and plasma concentrations, raising hypotension and adverse effect risk
avoid_foods.action: Completely avoid grapefruit; counsel patient on all citrus products and juices

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase tizanidine absorption and bioavailability compared to fasted state
caution_foods.action: Take tizanidine consistently with or without food; avoid sudden dietary changes

caution_foods.name: Caffeine-containing foods/beverages
caution_foods.mechanism: CYP1A2 substrate competition; caffeine may modestly reduce tizanidine metabolism or increase CNS stimulation offset
caution_foods.action: Limit caffeine intake; monitor for reduced efficacy or excessive sedation

monitoring_notes: Tizanidine is extensively metabolized by CYP1A2 (primary) and CYP3A4 (secondary), making it highly susceptible to inhibitor interactions causing hypotension and syncope. Monitor blood pressure and heart rate closely, especially when initiating or titrating; counsel patients on avoiding grapefruit and CYP1A2-inhibiting medications/supplements.
